interfaces.name: roll_horn
interfaces.what: Ø19 disc face with Ø6 blind recess and 4 x Ø2.4 on a Ø12 bolt circle at 0/90/180/270 deg, counterbored Ø4.84 from the rib side — the XL330 horn bolt pattern; the hip-roll servo in yaw2roll drives this face (MJCF: hip_l body origin at mesh (17.5, -18.5, 0), axis mesh -y)
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures + cad-mjcf sections, 2026-09-01

interfaces.name: roll_bearing_seat
interfaces.what: Ø16.0 x 1.95 boss — inner-race seat for the 22x16x4 bearing held in the yaw2roll body, coaxial with the hip-roll axis
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures (boss Ø16.00 len 1.95 at (17.5, -17.525, 0)), 2026-09-01

interfaces.name: pitch_horn
interfaces.what: Ø19 disc face with Ø6 blind recess and 4 x Ø2.4 on a Ø12 bolt circle, counterbored Ø4.84 (with Ø5.22 x 0.55 mouth steps) from the x=34 back face — the hip-pitch XL330's horn in the thigh bolts here (MJCF: hip-pitch joint through mesh (42.5, 0, 0) along x)
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures + cad-mjcf sections, 2026-09-01

interfaces.name: pitch_bearing_seat
interfaces.what: Ø16.0 x 1.95 boss — inner-race seat for the 22x16x4 bearing held in this hip_l body, coaxial with the hip-pitch axis
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures (boss Ø16.00 len 1.95 at (39.475, 0, 0)), 2026-09-01
